member.name: M:GrpcLibrary.KioskProcessor.FaceRecognition(GrpcLibrary.Dto.FaceRecognitionRequest)
member.summary: Compares two photos using face recognition and returns the result.
member.returns: The result of the comparison, including the verification status, distance, threshold, model, similarity metric, processing time, and overall status (e.g., success or error).
member.remarks:
image1
The first photo to compare, represented as a byte array.
image2
The second photo to compare, represented as a byte array.
threshold
The threshold value used to determine whether the photos represent the same person or different individuals. If not set, default values based on the model and distance metric will be applied.
model
The face recognition model to use. Options: VGG-Face, ArcFace, Dlib (default is Dlib).
similarity_metric
The similarity metric used for comparison. Options: 'cosine', 'euclidean', 'euclidean_l2' (default is cosine).
Default threshold values for the supported models (also differ per metric):
VGG-Face:
Threshold values:
- cosine: 0.68
- euclidean: 1.17
- euclidean_l2: 1.17
ArcFace:
Threshold values:
- cosine: 0.68
- euclidean: 4.15
- euclidean_l2: 1.13
Dlib:
Threshold values:
- cosine: 0.07
- euclidean: 0.60
- euclidean_l2: 0.40

member.name: T:GrpcLibrary.ServerProcessManager
member.summary:
Launches and stops the local face_snap server executable, for co-located deployments where the client owns the server's lifecycle.
It intentionally does nothing when: - the configured server address is remote (the server runs on another machine), - the server is already listening (development, or a previous instance), - the executable cannot be found (server started/managed some other way). Only a process this manager started is stopped.
